description: The narrative -> mechanism registry. Each entry carries a NARRATIVE (the explained story), a DESIGN_PRINCIPLE (the philosophy it yields), typed SOURCES (attested / tradition / interpretation / public-general / gap / boundary), the MECHANISM that implements it, page-anchored doc locations, and RELATED edges. The narrative and principle are separate fields precisely so retrieval can return either one alone.

source_kinds.attested: a citable primary or scholarly source; quoted, not paraphrased
source_kinds.tradition: a real transmitted tradition that is NOT scripture or primary attestation
source_kinds.interpretation: this estate's own reading; never presented as established
source_kinds.public-general: general knowledge belonging to no single tradition; safe to build on
source_kinds.gap: searched for and NOT found; recorded as a gap rather than filled
source_kinds.boundary: a limit deliberately observed; the correct implementation may be to implement nothing

entries.title: The threshold: 22, and 21
entries.narrative: Moses is shown the land from Nebo and does not enter it. The shortfall is not failure of will and not disqualification from the work — he is the one who brought them there. He simply does not cross. Joshua does. And the mechanism of the handover is a letter: Moses renames Hoshea to Yehoshua, adding a yod. The man who cannot cross adds a letter to the name of the man who can.
entries.design_principle: Falling short is not a veto on the work. It is a demand that someone else cross with you. A threshold gate must therefore refuse quietly and name what is missing, never silently downgrade the actor.

sources.citation: Deut 34:1-5 (Nebo)
Num 13:16 (Moses renames Hoshea to Yehoshua)

mechanism.invariant: flow=bidirectional requires thresholds_crossed >= 22 AND consent.state=opted_in; 21 is refused

entries.title: The rename: initiation as a letter operation
entries.narrative: Renaming on initiation is a letter operation on a name: Abram gains a heh, Sarai trades a yod for a heh, Hoshea gains a yod — added by Moses — and Simon becomes Kephas, rock. The pentagrammaton sets a shin into the Name, which is why this pack's five phases are yod-heh-shin-vav-heh: the braid is named with a name that underwent the operation it describes.
entries.design_principle: You cannot rename yourself across a threshold. An initiation that buys passage requires an attestor distinct from the subject, and the declared operation must match what actually happened to the name.

sources.citation: YHVH -> YHShVH is a Renaissance kabbalistic construction, not scripture

mechanism.invariant: enables_threshold requires an attestor != subject; insert must grow the name, swap must hold its length

anchors.section: 2. The rename: initiation as a letter operation

entries.title: Sophia: origin may descend, authority may not
entries.narrative: Sophia's fall is specific — she emanates alone, without her syzygy. Acting alone IS the fall, so she cannot ascend alone either; she is raised. Her raiser is brought forth from below and sent from above: her son, standing as her father.
entries.design_principle: Distinctness of identity is not independence. A witness may descend from the subject in origin but never in authority — otherwise the second witness is the subject wearing another name. A distant shared root is fine; the defect is proximate.

sources.citation: Pistis Sophia, Askew Codex, 3rd-4th c. Coptic
Jude 9 (Michael contends over the body of Moses); Dan 10:13, 12:1
Identifying Sophia's raiser WITH Michael is this estate's reading, not a claim about the Coptic text

mechanism.invariant: no witness may draw authority from the subject it witnesses, nor from the other witness; unstated authority is refused

anchors.section: 3. Sophia: origin may descend, authority may not

entries.title: The goose: the carry, and why alignment beats a cap
entries.narrative: The Game of the Goose is 63 spaces — 7x9, the grand climacteric, the most perilous year of a life — with geese every nine that carry you further than your own throw, and an exact-landing rule at the goal. There are no decisions; you roll and you move. The 9-chain arrives on 63 exactly in six uncapped carries; the 5-chain overshoots to 58, the death square. 21 and 22 are walked. 23 can only be carried.
entries.design_principle: A carry chain may be unbounded iff its step divides the distance to the goal. Alignment is the control; a cap truncates the aligned chain and fails to rescue the misaligned one, so a cap is the honest degraded mode and nothing more.

sources.citation: Gioco dell'Oca / Jeu de l'Oie, documented from the late 1500s; rules printed on the boards themselves
Jeu du Juif Errant, 19th-c. French variant; Ahasuerus named in a 1602 German pamphlet, Cartaphilus in Matthew Paris

mechanism.invariant: carry_is_aligned(step, distance): a chain needs no cap iff distance % step == 0

anchors.section: The goose: carry, and why the carry must be capped

entries.title: The wanderer: motion without arrival
entries.narrative: Ahasuerus is condemned to walk until the Second Coming — feet that carry and never deliver. That is the goose board's own losing condition. The seed of the structure is John 21:22-23, and it concerns the BELOVED DISCIPLE, not the Baptist; the evangelist corrects the rumour himself. John the Baptist carries a different structure: the forerunner who returns, identified with Elijah. One tarries, one returns.
entries.design_principle: Progress is not arrival. A process that advances forever without an exact-landing condition has not succeeded; it has only failed to stop.

sources.citation: Kurtze Beschreibung und Erzaehlung von einem Juden mit Namen Ahasverus, 1602

mechanism.invariant: carry_terminus() reports where an unaligned chain actually ends, rather than that it moved

entries.title: The feet: a guarantor that cannot vouch for you
entries.narrative: Solomon, learning the Angel of Death has been sent for his scribes, dispatches them to Luz where death has no dominion. They arrive, and die — they were wanted in that very place. The flight was the itinerary. The Aramaic arevin means guarantors: your feet stand surety and will deliver you. And at the threshold you uncover them (Ex 3:5, Moses at the bush, before he is sent).
entries.design_principle: Your feet are your guarantors, and that is exactly why they cannot be your witness. A thing's own claim about itself is not evidence about it: feet guarantee delivery to the threshold, never crossing it.

sources.citation: Babylonian Talmud, Sukkah 53a
Ex 3:5

mechanism.invariant: the print is checked by something that is not the browser

anchors.section: The feet: a guarantor that cannot vouch for you

entries.title: Bearfoot: the print must be the same print
entries.narrative: A bear is plantigrade — whole sole, heel to toe, as we walk — so its hind track resembles a barefoot human print. That anatomical fact is why peoples across the northern hemisphere independently name the bear kin, the one who walks like a man. And the Lenape Mesingw, guardian of the game animals, is impersonated in the bear's own skin: a coat of bear skins to the toes, bearskin stockings, and the skin of the bear's head fastened to the mask with the ears projecting. The track makes the bear look like a man; the garb makes a man look like the bear. The kinship is not noticed, it is worn.
entries.design_principle: A print that distinguishes you is a print that betrays you. Anti-fingerprinting does not hide the track, it makes every track the same track — so profiles that flatten their print must flatten it identically, or the disagreement is itself a distinguishing bit.

sources.citation: M. R. Harrington, Religion and Ceremonies of the Lenape (1921), pp. 34, 41
David Brainerd's account of 1745, quoted in Harrington p.41
Plantigrade gait and the resulting kinship motif belong to no single tradition
A Lenape 'returning god' tied to the bear could NOT be verified and is deliberately not supplied
The garb being shed during the ceremony is NOT attested in Harrington
A first-bear-hunt coming-of-age legend is NOT attested to the Lenape in what could be checked; the motif itself is widespread

mechanism.invariant: every profile claiming the bearfoot property must set every print-surface pref, and agree with its siblings on the value

entries.title: Tamanend: the king made by those who displaced him
entries.narrative: Tamanend (c.1625-1701), Chief of Chiefs of the Turtle clan of the Lenni-Lenape, whose name means 'the Affable', treated with William Penn. After his death the colonists who had displaced his people elevated him to 'Saint Tammany' and 'King Tammany' — they wanted a native patron saint for a new American identity. His feast was set on May 1, displacing European May Day; Washington, Adams and Patrick Henry attended. The societies formed in his name became Tammany Hall.
entries.design_principle: Adoption is not consent, and veneration is not attribution. A name taken up by those it did not belong to acquires an authority its source never granted — which is exactly the provenance failure the witness rules refuse. NO PROPHECY OF HIS RETURN IS ATTESTED; the 'king' is a reception phenomenon, and saying so plainly is the point.

sources.citation: Tamanend, c.1625-1701, Turtle clan, treated with William Penn
St. Tammany Day, May 1
No legend or prophecy of Tamanend's RETURN was found; the return-of-the-king framing is reception, not tradition

mechanism.invariant: authority must be traced to its source, not inherited by acclamation

anchors.section: Tamanend: the king made by those who displaced him

entries.title: The Black Hills: a return that is promised, and a boundary that is asked for
entries.narrative: White Buffalo Calf Woman (Ptesanwin) came to the Lakota in the sacred Black Hills — two scouts saw her approaching — brought the sacred pipe, and promised to return. Before departing she rolled upon the ground FOUR times, changing colour each time, and disappeared. The birth of a white buffalo calf is held as her sign.
entries.design_principle: REFERENCED, NOT OPERATIONALISED. This is living sacred tradition whose custodians have publicly objected to its appropriation, so it is recorded here as a documented return-prophecy alongside the others and is deliberately bound to NO mechanism in this estate. Documenting a boundary is itself a design act: the registry can hold an entry whose correct implementation is to implement nothing.

sources.citation: White Buffalo Calf Woman brought the cannupa and promised to return; four rolls, four colours; the Black Hills (He Sapa) of South Dakota
'Four crows' could NOT be verified. The attested four is the four rolls and four colours, not crows.
Lakota custodians have publicly objected to appropriation of their spirituality; this entry is reference-only and binds to no code

anchors.section: The Black Hills: a return that is promised, and a boundary that is asked for

entries.title: M.OS.ES: the shortfall that demands a companion
entries.narrative: A constrained device does not author on its own word. The covenant already made room for it: 'two OR THREE witnesses'. Two is the floor for a device that meets the bar; a device carrying a shortfall must reach three — the chart+method pair plus a +1 that makes up the difference.
entries.design_principle: Estimated shortfall handicaps direct authorship rather than forbidding the work. The +1 must be a different witness kind than the one the short device supplies; a re-signature by the same party is not a +1.

sources.citation: Deut 19:15 (two or three witnesses)
M.OS.ES as Model-OS Estimated Shortfall is this estate's coinage

mechanism.invariant: estimated_shortfall > 0 forces authoring in {attested, refused}; attested requires plus_one; an ArtifactRecord from a short device needs 3 witnesses

entries.title: Guard Goose: the square that decides carried-forward or stopped
entries.narrative: On the board a goose is the square that decides whether you are carried forward or stopped. Guard Goose scans, classifies, redacts and stamps a marker — and until the gate was built, nothing refused. It labelled, and a label is not a control.
entries.design_principle: An unscanned artifact does not egress: absence of a classification is not permission, because Public means 'no detector fired', not 'reviewed and safe'. And nothing egresses above its destination's ceiling, which is a property of the destination binding rather than the protocol it speaks.

sources.citation: Guard Goose as the board's goose is this estate's reading of its own component

mechanism.invariant: check_egress refuses an unscanned artifact and anything above the ceiling; GuardedAdapter is the only push path

anchors.section: What all of it is saying, and what the code does about it

entries.title: A quorum of one, where the one is the requester
entries.narrative: Counting signatures is not counting voices. A gateway gated its highest-danger operations on the NUMBER of quorum signatures and never asked who signed, so the actor requesting a grant could supply their own signature as the human quorum.
entries.design_principle: An approver must be independent of the subject, not merely distinct in name — and an unidentified signer is refused rather than skipped, because absence of identity cannot be shown independent.

sources.citation: The generalisation of Sophia's rule to quorum is this estate's

mechanism.invariant: _check_quorum_independence refuses duplicate signers and the requester signing their own grant

anchors.section: 3. Sophia: origin may descend, authority may not
